entities.name: J. P. Bordeleau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Pierre Bordeleau is a Canadian former professional ice hockey player who played 519 NHL games between 1970 and 1980, all for the Chicago Black Hawks, the team that drafted him in the first round of the 1969 NHL Amateur Draft. He featured in the 1973 Stanley Cup Finals.
